quote.text: Do not try to seem wise to others.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace authenticity: When guiding your children, let your truth and actions be the lesson rather than putting on a facade of wisdom.
    • Model humility: Prioritize genuine understanding and compassion over seeking admiration, so your children learn that real wisdom grows quietly.
  • Leadership
    • Lead by example: True leadership is demonstrated through action and integrity — making decisions that benefit all without the need for external validation.
    • Foster an environment of honest growth: Encourage a culture where admitting limitations is seen as a strength, not a weakness, promoting continual learning.
  • Product Management
    • Focus on impact over image: In product management, let the value you create speak for itself rather than trying to project an image of superior insight.
    • Prioritize thoughtful iteration: Build solutions iteratively, using feedback and genuine insight to improve, rather than relying on the appearance of infallible wisdom.
